description: Reference rows (FAM-19, stock): GetLocations, AddRoomCmdLocationRow and ExtractRoomActions over the stock Obtained From, References, Summoned By, Learned From, Casted By and Assigned To texts.
notes: Each case is a list of GetLocations calls (arguments written out in order: text, list, bDontClear, sHeader, nAuxValue, bTwoColumns, bDontSort, bPercentColumn, sFooter, nLimit) on one recording ListView; output 'rows' is [Text, Tag, cells] per row, a cell [Text, Tag, ForeColor] or its Text alone.
ListView sorting is a skipped feature: SortListView is bound to a recorder, so rows are in the order MME adds them and the events 'sort_listview' give the row count at each sort request.
GetLairInfo answers from data.lairs (invented numbers on the real group indexes), as in the lairs family.
data.items/monsters/spells/shops/rooms are the stock rows the cases can reach (chests and shops open further texts, so it is a closure); the Rust test answers its lookups from them.
